name: Retrograde
source:
Throughout time, legends and myths about the sun and moon have always been in play.
Be it through the lullabies of parents, through the ballads of the bards, or as a merry song in a tavern, the sun and moon will always be the subject of such artistry.

Join Johnathan and Ashleigh as they discover who they are in this whimsical adventure across time and space. From finding out their roles, to figuring out what their place is in this dramatical play of political intrigue, conspiracies, and even meeting themselves in the future. What secrets are kept from them, and what answers will they find?

There is only one way to find out, and only a risk that few would dare take.

Take the Path of the Retrograde.

[From [url=https://salthymn.itch.io/retrograde]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
古往今来，关于太阳和月亮的传说和神话一直在流传。
无论是父母的摇篮曲、吟游诗人的歌谣，还是酒馆里的欢歌，太阳和月亮永远是这种艺术的主题。

与乔纳森和阿什莉一起，在这场跨越时空的异想天开的冒险中发现自己的身份。从找出他们的角色，到弄清楚他们在这场政治阴谋、阴谋的戏剧中的位置，甚至在未来与自己相遇。他们有哪些秘密，他们会找到什么答案？

只有一种方法可以找到答案，而且只有一种很少有人敢冒的风险。

走逆行之路。

[来自[url=https://salthymn.itch.io/retrograde]Itch.io[/url]]
